title: FLOP network observation
description: Reads the FLOP Network's own read surface through its hosted MCP server: chain stats, realized settlements, session offers and model pricing.

actions.reason: Record the network's current state before any earning decision.
Record realized settlements so pricing is taken from the tape, not from memory.

evidence_contract: Chain stats (block height, TPS, active operators) are recorded.
The five most recent realized settlements and their price per GFLOP are recorded.
safety_notes: Read-only: the tool cannot post, sign or spend.
Only allowlisted MCP tools are callable; a tool the server adds later is refused until reviewed.
Responses are trimmed before they reach the model context.
